# Grabbit

Grabbit is a free online video downloader developed by LM Logics. Paste an eligible public link to save an MP4 from your browser. The optional Windows app offers more video and audio formats.

- Website: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/
- Windows and Android releases: https://github.com/zubulika/Grabbit/releases/latest
- Documentation: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/docs

## Video download guides

- Facebook videos and Reels: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/video-downloader/facebook
- Instagram Reels and video posts: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/video-downloader/instagram
- YouTube videos and Shorts: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/video-downloader/youtube
- TikTok videos: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/video-downloader/tiktok
- X (Twitter) video posts: https://grabbit.lmlogics.com/video-downloader/x
